response.sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.type, t.amount, t.balance, d.A3 AS region FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id), acct AS (SELECT region, account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount END) AS avg_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM valid GROUP BY region, account_id), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance FROM acct GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_amount FROM reg) SELECT r.region, r.avg_amount, r.avg_balance, r.avg_amount / NULLIF(o.mean_amount, 0) AS amount_ratio FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_amount IS NOT NULL AND o.mean_amount <> 0;
